explanations.24: This function converts single characters to lowercase (like 'A' to 'a') but leaves multi-character key names like 'ArrowUp' unchanged, because arrow keys shouldn't be lowercased.
explanations.30: progressRef stores a number that persists across re-renders without causing the component to re-render; it tracks how many keys in the Konami sequence the user has correctly typed so far.
explanations.46: event.repeat is true when the user holds down a key and the OS fires repeated 'keydown' events; we skip those to avoid breaking sequences where the same key appears twice in a row.
explanations.61: If the user pressed the wrong key, we either reset to 1 (if they happened to press the first key of the sequence) or reset to 0 (starting fresh), so they can retry the whole sequence.
